company_name: SGL Carbon Far East Ltd. Shanghai
semiconductor_relevance: High — SGL Carbon Far East Ltd. specializes in high-purity graphite and composite materials essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: SGL Carbon Far East Ltd. produces high-quality graphite and composite materials that are critical in the semiconductor industry, particularly for applications requiring ultrahigh purity. Their product offerings include fine grain graphite, insulation felt, and specialized graphite products for crystal growth applications.
capabilities: Graphite products for Si and SiC crystal growth
CFC and PBN materials for process chamber components
technical_expertise: Material science for ultrahigh purity graphite

regional_presence.China: SGL Carbon Far East Ltd. operates in Shanghai, focusing on the semiconductor and other advanced technology sectors.
